docs.title: About Us
docs.text: About Us Our God is able Portal Request a School Visit Search this site Since 2016 A Brief History Treasure Academy was founded in 2016 by Shaibu Sidikat Ruth to serve children and families in Ageva, Okene. The school began with a clear purpose: to help children grow in knowledge, character and confidence. The school offers Pre-Nursery, Nursery 1–2, Primary 1–4 and Primary 6 . Its stated focus is to build strong academic foundations, good character and readiness for each child's next stage. Families are encouraged to visit the school and ask the office to confirm current facilities, class arrangements and availability. Our Mission To help children grow in knowledge, character and confidence through strong academics, clear guidance and good morals. Our Vision To nurture confident, capable and well-mannered children who are ready for the next stage of their education. Our Values Discipline · Excellence · Respect · Integrity Verified Information Registration & Approvals Official details families can use to identify our school. docs.title: Visiting the School
docs.text: Use the website Request Centre to ask for a school visit, then follow the office response. Do not publish a child list, medical file or other unnecessary private information in a public message.
docs.keywords: visit tour appointment school office request

docs.title: Homework Is Offline
docs.text: Teachers may publish clear homework instructions, but the website does not accept pupil uploads or online assignment submissions. Pupils complete and return work through the school-approved offline process.
docs.keywords: homework assignment submit upload online offline teacher

docs.title: Primary 6 Common Entrance Practice
docs.text: The CBT-style activity is only for Primary 6 Common Entrance practice. It is practice, not an official examination or published result.
docs.keywords: cbt common entrance practice primary 6 exam

docs.title: School Materials Orders
docs.text: Verified school materials belong in the signed-in parent portal. Physical products use sizes or variants, real stock reservations and office collection or teacher handover after release. Unavailable items use a restock request; term fees and transport are not cart products.
docs.keywords: shop materials uniform stock size order collection teacher handover restock

docs.title: School Transport Requests
docs.text: A linked parent requests transport in the signed-in portal. The school reviews route and capacity before issuing any service invoice. Transport does not change physical stock and a request does not guarantee a place.
docs.keywords: transport route capacity request invoice linked pupil

docs.title: Graduate Hall and Graduate Wall
docs.text: Graduation keeps the permanent pupil identity and history. Parents see their linked former pupils privately in Your Graduates. The public Graduate Wall shows only a consent-approved display name, graduation session and optional message.
docs.keywords: graduate hall wall alumni consent former pupil your graduates

docs.title: Birthday Privacy
docs.text: Birthday information is limited to authorised staff and the Headmistress. Pupil and staff birthday dates are not published on the public website.
docs.keywords: birthday privacy staff headmistress pupil date
